name: Apex Legends

scale.why: assumed like Titanfall 2: a 72 u (inch) tall hull scaled to 1.8 m, 0.025 m/u (the wiki converts at 1 u = 1 inch = 0.0254 m, 1.6% more)

speed.note: sprint; walk 199.53 u/s, crouch-walk 92 u/s; -13% holding a weapon

hook_range.note: Pathfinder's Grappling Hook (tactical); the wiki lists a 20 s cooldown and 2 charges

gravity.source: https://apexmovement.tech/wiki/tech/General%20Tech%3EFundamentals%3EGround%3EFundamental%20Ground%20Movement%20article (jump height 56 u, airtime 0.74 s on flat ground)
gravity.note: derived from the measured jump: g = 8 x height / airtime^2 (Titanfall 2's pilots: 750 x 0.8 = 600 u/s2)

jump.note: derived from the measured jump: take-off speed = 4 x height / airtime

air_cap.note: the movement wiki's core air value, read as Source's air wish cap (Titanfall 2's player dump has the same airSpeed 60)

air_accel.note: as Titanfall 2: if the 500 is an absolute u/s2 push toward the 60 u/s cap, the Quark-equivalent is 500 / 60 / 10; the engine's formula isn't public

step.source: https://apexmovement.tech/wiki/tech/General%20Tech%3EFundamentals%3EGround%3EFundamental%20Ground%20Movement%20article (overwalkable ledge about 30 hu, higher on rounded or sloped ledges)
step.note: the highest ledge you walk over without jumping or mantling

dash.note: no dash for most legends (Octane / Horizon / Pathfinder have movement abilities)

slideTime.source: https://apexlegends.wiki.gg/wiki/Sliding (about 1 s on flat ground before it slows)

jumpFatigue.value: 16.3 u for 0.15 s after landing, back to 56 u by 0.75 s
jumpFatigue.note: a jump right after landing is lower

extras: slide (about 1 s on flat ground, longer downhill)
jump fatigue: a jump within 0.15 s of landing reaches only about 30% height, recovering by 0.75 s (Apex Movement Wiki)
bunny hops above sprint speed lose up to 100 u/s each; no air friction (horizontal speed is kept in the air)
legend hulls are 66, 72 or 80 u tall (16 u radius), so the 72 u scale here is the middle size
notes: Apex's data files aren't public; numbers are community measurements. The Fandom wiki converts the same 299 u/s at 1 u = 0.75 in (5.7 m/s); this file uses the player-height scale. Gravity and jump speed are derived from the Apex Movement Wiki's measured jump (56 u high, 0.74 s in the air), so they are estimates; the air values are the same 60 / 500 Titanfall 2 uses.
